criteria.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs: `event_of_job` loads the job's stored candidate and, for each criterion the verification marks unmet, appends to `what` the producer's pre-verdict status and evidence taken from `candidate.producer_report.criteria_check` (clipped with the existing caps). A criterion the producer did not list is shown as having no recorded pre-verdict check. Nothing is added when the verification passed or no candidate/report is stored.
criteria.evidence: From reading the code (introspect.rs:1564-1570): `event_of_job` passes `job_records.candidate.as_ref().and_then(|c| c.producer_report.as_ref())` to `failure_details`. `pre_verdict_block` (added near line 1000) matches each unmet criterion with `criterion_key`, applies `clip(.., TEXT_CAP)` and `.take(DETAIL_CAP)`, and writes "no pre-verdict check recorded" for any criterion the producer did not list. A passing verdict still returns early at line 1049, and the block is only built when the unmet list is not empty. The existing test `a_job_without_verification_or_without_failures_keeps_the_old_what` passes. There is one deviation from the literal text: a failed job with no candidate or report gets one line saying no pre-verdict check was recorded. Criterion 3 explicitly asks for that line, so the two criteria conflict; the change follows criterion 3 and the CHANGELOG explains this. No status or evidence is ever invented.

criteria.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs, in the style of `an_event_carries_the_unmet_criterion_and_the_major_finding`, commits a Candidate whose producer_report marks criterion C as met with some evidence plus a failed Verification with C unmet. It calls `event_of_job` and asserts `what` contains C's pre-verdict status and evidence. It fails on the base tree and passes with the change; check with `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`.
criteria.evidence: `an_unmet_criterion_shows_the_producers_pre_verdict_check` passed in my run. It commits a real Candidate record through `athena_with_candidate` and calls `event_of_job`. It asserts that `what` contains "- C: the producer marked it met" and "its evidence: ran the new test and it passed", including the `[behavior] ... .` variant of the criterion text. Athena's fails-without-2 run with the fix reverted exited 101 because the test did not compile: `ProducerReport` is not imported and `NO_PRE_VERDICT_CHECK` does not exist on base. On base the assertions would fail anyway, because base `event_of_job` never reads the candidate.

criteria.criterion: A second new test covers an unmet criterion absent from criteria_check, and a job with no stored candidate. It asserts `what` states no pre-verdict check was recorded and that the existing assertions on `what` (unmet list, major findings, failed checks) still hold; check with `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`.
criteria.evidence: Three new tests passed in my run: `an_unmet_criterion_with_no_pre_verdict_check_says_so` (another criterion listed, an empty list, and `producer_report: None`), `a_job_without_a_candidate_says_no_pre_verdict_check_was_recorded`, which asserts the phrase together with "Unmet acceptance criteria (1):", "- C", the major-finding line, "Failed checks" and "- test: thread panicked", and `the_producers_pre_verdict_evidence_is_capped`. When Athena reverted the fix (fails-without-3), the tests did not compile (exit 101).

criteria.criterion: The root cause is named in the CHANGELOG.md entry (a new entry; docs/decisions.md and records/ are not edited): the self-check was already stored in candidate.producer_report, but the introspection event built in `event_of_job` never included it, so the stage that reports the failure could not see the check.
criteria.evidence: There is a new bullet at the top of ### Fixed: "Root cause: the producer's self-check ... was already stored in `candidate.producer_report.criteria_check`, but the introspection event built in `event_of_job` ... read only the outcome reason and `verification.json`, so the stage that reports the failure could not see the check." The diff changes only CHANGELOG.md, introspect.rs and send_back.rs; docs/decisions.md and records/ are not touched.

criteria.criterion: Existing introspect and run_pin tests still pass: `cargo test` passes on the final tree, as does `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`, as recorded by Athena's checks.
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded checks for 55acbcd5 (CI run 43753902885): fmt, clippy and `cargo test --locked` all passed. My targeted run of `cargo test -p athena-core introspect` gave 36 passed and 0 failed, including the existing introspect tests.

findings.summary: Criteria 1 and 3 contradict each other about a job with no stored candidate; the change follows criterion 3.
findings.evidence: Criterion 1 says nothing is added when no candidate or report is stored. Criterion 3 requires `what` to say no pre-verdict check was recorded for a job with no candidate. The code adds one line, "... no pre-verdict check recorded (the job has no stored producer report).", and the CHANGELOG states this choice. The accepted plan's demonstrations asked for this same behavior.

findings.summary: A producer criterion that was reworded is reported as "no pre-verdict check recorded", which overstates what is missing.
findings.evidence: Criteria are matched by exact equality after `criterion_key` normalisation. If the producer checked a paraphrased version of the criterion, the event says no check was recorded, when the truth is that no entry matched. A wording such as "no matching entry in the producer's criteria_check" would be more accurate. The CHANGELOG mentions this limit.

findings.summary: With the fix reverted, the new tests fail to compile rather than failing on their assertions.
findings.evidence: Athena's fails-without-2, -3 and -5 runs all exited 101 with E0425 for `ProducerReport` and `NO_PRE_VERDICT_CHECK`. Base `event_of_job` never reads the candidate, so the assertions would also fail there, but no run shows that directly.

summary: The change passes. Introspection events for failed jobs now show what the producer itself recorded for each unmet criterion before the verdict. In `event_of_job`, the stored `candidate.producer_report` is now passed to `failure_details`, which adds the producer's own status and evidence for each unmet criterion (or "no pre-verdict check recorded"), capped by DETAIL_CAP and clipped to TEXT_CAP. `criterion_key` was moved into introspect.rs, made `pub(crate)`, and is now imported by send_back.rs, so both places match criteria the same way. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`: 36 tests passed, including the four new ones. When Athena reverted the fix, the new tests did not compile, so they do fail on the base tree. The CHANGELOG entry names the root cause. Athena's CI records show fmt, clippy and the full test suite passing. Only the three expected files changed. Two minor points: criteria 1 and 3 contradict each other about the no-candidate case, and the change follows criterion 3 and says why; and a producer criterion that was reworded is reported as "no pre-verdict check recorded".
